assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape character design sheet for a gentle 3D woodland learning game for first-grade children in Zürich. Two distinct rows on warm ivory paper, with generous whitespace and a professional animation-model reference layout. Top row Fuchs: small upright red fox, orange fur, cream muzzle and belly, dark paws, full bushy tail with cream tip, a plain forest-green neckerchief. Bottom row Waldkauz: tawny owl with round brown body, softly layered feather shapes, round facial discs, large warm dark eyes, small beak, no ear tufts; wings remain articulated and readable. Each row shows front, side, back and three-quarter full body views with consistent proportions, and two small expressions, curious and pleased for Fuchs, puzzled and relieved for Waldkauz. Soft stylised 3D clay/painted-wood surfaces, rounded geometry suitable for real-time models, no individual fur strands, restrained rich woodland colours, matte soft studio lighting and subtle contact shadows. Owl is warmly thoughtful and elderly, never a caricature, no glasses or invented costume. Clean silhouettes easily readable at tablet game scale. Only text: Fuchs above top row, Waldkauz above bottom row. No logos, watermarks, photo realism, weapons or extra accessories. This is a reference sheet, not a sprite sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Wide landscape 4:3 art-only scene concept for a gentle 3D woodland learning game for children in Zürich. Interior of a small fox den beneath an enormous tree: elevated three-quarter cutaway camera sees the floor and a cosy room framed by rounded earth walls and tree roots. Small orange upright red fox with cream muzzle and belly, dark paws, large bushy cream-tipped tail and plain forest-green neckerchief stands slightly left of centre. Clear round doorway at the back right opens onto a sunny green woodland path. A simple wooden bed with moss-green blanket at left, low wooden drawing table with blank paper and wooden pencils at bottom right, one honey-coloured shelf and basket near the wall. Large empty unobstructed oval floor space in the middle for placing future furniture, small plain cream cushion near the bed. Warm ivory, woodland green, honey timber and muted terracotta; luminous diffuse daylight through doorway and little root window; soft matte stylised 3D game render, rounded low complexity forms, tactile painted wood and clay. Scene is warm, expressive and spacious, not cluttered, not dark, no household appliances, no human furniture scale, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Keep major objects visually separate and reachable, camera below ceiling roots.

Use case: stylized-concept. Wide landscape 4:3 art-only scene concept for a welcoming 3D Swiss lowland woodland learning game, shown by an elevated following camera. A small upright orange fox with cream muzzle, dark paws, full cream-tipped tail and a plain green neckerchief stands on a broad sandy path in the lower middle facing a central clearing. Left centre is an immense old leafy tree with visible round den entrance between its roots. Nearby at right is a smaller tree with an open wooden shop counter and a few simple cushions and apples. Distinct paths branch towards a red squirrel at a nut tree on upper left, a tiny blue-and-yellow blue tit on a low singing branch, and a sparkling brook to the right with a safe simple footbridge and a beaver at a workbench. Keep animals small environmental inhabitants rather than a crowd of foreground portraits. Solid rounded leafy crowns, gently sloping moss-green ground, scattered flowers, hazel/broadleaf lowland forest, blue stream water and warm honey wood. Layered depth, restrained soft shadows, matte stylised 3D game art with painted-wood/clay-like materials and clear silhouettes. Calm exploration, no fences blocking every path, no dangerous ledges, no mountain vista, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermarks. Big tree must read as the central home landmark, broad paths legible at tablet size.
